messages:
elaine: Heads-up — customer PlutoMaps (dedicated) reported rerank p95 spike and ~10-20% 504s during a nightly bulk rerank job. Started 2024-11-07 ~09:14 UTC. They send batches of ~64 items, QPS ~120 for a 10m window. Gateway retries observed.

elaine: Example error from gateway: 
  504 Gateway Timeout (upstream response timeout)
  trace_id: trace-x-0001

elaine: Repro payload (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "r-rerank-v1",
  "inputs": [["doc1","doc2",...]],
  "batch_size": 64,
  "sort_by": "score"
}
```
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>, X-Client-Id: pluto-42

simon: thanks — can you paste the gateway logs for trace-x-0001 and any backend ids? also curious about retry headers (x-retries) and any 5xx from the ranking backend.

elaine: pasted last 5 lines from gateway logs: 
```
[09:14:33] upstream timeout to backend-ranker-7 (504) trace=trace-x-0001
[09:14:33] retrying request (1/3) backoff=30ms
[09:14:33] upstream timeout to backend-ranker-8 (504) trace=trace-x-0001
[09:14:35] request dropped due to circuit open for route /v1/rerank
[09:14:36] client disconnect
```

nina: I pulled infra traces — backend-ranker instances show increased read latency to KV cache around same time (lots of cache misses). Disk IO up and per-token processing time jumped. Also saw transient 502 from a quantized model variant that had been rolled yesterday.

nina: hypothesis: large batch_size -> KV cache miss storm + one variant fallback (quantized variant) triggering heavier CPU usage = long tail + gateway retries amplifying load.

kevin: quick mitigation for customer: lower batch_size to 16 or 8, set max_retries=1 at gateway for this route, and pin model variant to non-quantized for their tenant. I'll push a temporary canary config.

kevin: suggested config snippet:
```yaml
routes:
  - path: /v1/rerank
    tenant: pluto-42
    circuit_breaker: {failure_threshold: 0.05, window_ms: 60000}
    retry_policy: {max_retries: 1, backoff_ms: 50}
    model_pin: r-rerank-v1:stable
```

elaine: I've asked PlutoMaps to test with batch_size=16, they reported immediate drop in 504s. Applying kevin's routing change now.

ops-bot: deploy_event: rolled back model-variant r-rerank-v1:quant-2024-11-06 for tenant pluto-42 by kevin at 09:27 UTC — change id dep-8721.

simon: follow-ups: we should add automated detection for large-batch KV-miss storms (alert on backend read latency correlated with batch_size > 32), and add a tenant-level soft limit on batch_size with clear 4xx error explaining recommended size.

nina: Agreed. I'll open an infra ticket to add the alert and a short-term dashboard tile for KV miss rate by tenant.

elaine: Customer escalated to SE (copied). They want root-cause timeline and repro steps — I'll attach traces and the before/after QPS/504 graphs.

kevin: +1. Also recommend updating docs for rerank payload limits and our recommended batch sizing heuristics. :thumbsup:

elaine: cc @support-escalations — marking as mitigated for now, leaving open until infra alert and docs task are created.
